messages.subject: Meridian - execution logistics
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Now that the legal points are agreed, proposing we exchange executed counterparts by email/PDF on Thursday 27 November. Sentvia will be signed by Daniel Reisman (CEO). Could you confirm Hartwell's signatory and we'll prepare the execution versions of the agreement and schedules?

Priya
